description: Extend the central role catalogue and Keycloak realm export from 6 roles to the full canonical set (~30: 6 existing + the new domain roles enumerated in plan.md 0.4), keeping the 6 existing roles byte-for-byte. Add each new role to KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES (roles.ts), to DEFAULT_ROLES (rbac.ts) with a privilege-preserving permission set derived as the union of its gateway-registry definition and the module allow-lists that name it, and to infra/keycloak/proctira-realm.json. Add a realm<->catalogue<->gateway parity regression test. Depends on FEAT-001 (canonical spellings must exist first). Closes PRC-M015 (parity half) and advances L174/M237/M521/L276/L347/L391 vocabulary findings to their dispositions in plan.md.
steps: Read .agents/plan.md sections 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 and context.json FIRST; FEAT-001 must already be committed on this branch. Re-run the backend role-literal scan to produce the authoritative final canonical list (plan.md 0.4 is the expected set); record the exact count in findings -- do NOT force it to 30 by dropping a real role, and do NOT add moderator/accountant/hostel_* or other out-of-scope aliases.

Edit packages/backend/auth/src/keycloak/roles.ts: append the new canonical role ids to the KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES tuple AFTER the existing six (super-admin, admin, principal, teacher, staff, guardian), preserving those six first and unchanged. Do not modify mapKeycloakRoles/extractKeycloakRoleNames logic.

Edit packages/shared/auth/src/rbac.ts: append a RoleDefinition for each new role to DEFAULT_ROLES, keeping the six existing entries byte-for-byte. Set permissions[] per plan.md 0.5: for roles defined in createGatewayRbacRegistry (platform_admin, registrar, hr_officer, staff_admin, admissions_officer, counsellor, discipline_officer, nurse, parent, student) copy that gateway permission block exactly; for the rest derive narrowly from the module allow-lists that name them mapped through PATH_RESOURCE_MAP. Grant the LEAST set consistent with current effective access; never grant *:manage unless the role already holds it (only platform_admin/super-admin do). Flag any role whose correct set is ambiguous rather than over-granting.

Edit infra/keycloak/proctira-realm.json: append { "name": "<id>", "description": "<human description>" } for each new role to roles.realm[], after the existing six (unchanged). Do not touch clients/users/protocolMappers.

Update packages/backend/auth/src/keycloak/roles.test.ts: change the keycloakRoleCatalog expectation from the six-id array to the full ordered id list. Add a mapKeycloakRoles test proving ['registrar','examinations_officer','platform_admin'] now map to assignments (the former silent-drop is closed) with roleName matching DEFAULT_ROLES.

Add a parity regression test (PRC-M015) under packages/backend/auth/src (and optionally apps/api-gateway/src) asserting: (a) set(KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES) === set(roles.realm[].name from the realm JSON) === set(DEFAULT_ROLES.map(roleId)); (b) every role id used in createGatewayRbacRegistry() output exists in KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES.

Run server-guard then verification; commit locally citing PRC-M015 (and the advanced ids). Set status completed; in findings record the final role count, the per-new-role permission derivation (one line each), and any role flagged ambiguous for the reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES, DEFAULT_ROLES role ids, and infra/keycloak/proctira-realm.json roles.realm[].name are three mutually-equal sets.
The six original roles are unchanged in all three artifacts (ids, order-first, and the six DEFAULT_ROLES permission blocks byte-for-byte; the six realm JSON entries unchanged).
No new role is granted a permission beyond its current effective grant; platform_admin/super-admin remain the only holders of *:manage.
parent, guardian, nurse, school_nurse all appear as distinct catalogue entries.
mapKeycloakRoles now returns assignments for the newly-added realm roles (proven by test); roles.test.ts catalogue expectation updated and green.
The realm JSON parses; the parity test passes; every gateway-registry role id exists in the catalogue.
pnpm --filter @proctira/auth --filter @proctira/backend-auth --filter @proctira/api-gateway test green; tsc --noEmit clean; eslint+prettier clean on changed files.
verification: pnpm --filter @proctira/auth run typecheck ; pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-auth run typecheck ; pnpm --filter @proctira/api-gateway run typecheck
npx prettier --check <changed files> ; npx eslint <changed files>
findings:
FINAL ROLE COUNT = 39 (6 original + 33 new). This exceeds the decision doc's '~30' estimate and is reported honestly, not forced: plan.md 0.4's enumerated set already lists parent/student/applicant and the government/board actors, and the acceptance criterion 'every gateway-registry role id exists in the catalogue' forces parent + student (gateway-defined) into all three artifacts. No out-of-scope aliases (moderator/accountant/hostel_*/super_admin/system-admin/instructor/faculty/hod/scheduler/invigilator/fees_clerk/cashier/etc.) were added; those remain byte-for-byte in their module allow-lists. The 6 original roles (super-admin, admin, principal, teacher, staff, guardian) are unchanged and order-first in KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES, DEFAULT_ROLES, and infra/keycloak/proctira-realm.json. parent/guardian and nurse/school_nurse are kept distinct. system_admin was NOT added as a realm role (platform_admin is its canonical target; FEAT-001 added platform_admin alongside system_admin in the allow-lists). PARITY: new api-gateway/src/role-catalogue-parity.test.ts asserts realm JSON == KEYCLOAK_REALM_ROLES == DEFAULT_ROLES ids (as sets), no duplicates, 6-original-first, every createGatewayRbacRegistry() role id is in the catalogue, and platform_admin+super-admin are the ONLY *:manage holders. roles.test.ts proves mapKeycloakRoles(['registrar','examinations_officer','platform_admin']) now returns assignments (former silent-drop closed) with roleName matching DEFAULT_ROLES.

PER-NEW-ROLE PERMISSION DERIVATION (privilege-preserving union):
- platform_admin: gateway block verbatim -> platform:manage, *:manage (absorbs system_admin module usages).
- registrar: gateway STAFF_HR_PERMISSIONS -> staff:manage.
- hr_officer: gateway STAFF_HR_PERMISSIONS -> staff:manage.
- staff_admin: gateway STAFF_HR_PERMISSIONS -> staff:manage.
- admissions_officer: gateway STAFF_HR_PERMISSIONS -> staff:manage.
- bursar: scholarship decide/disburse + staff.hr.read/payroll + report fee_dues -> scholarship:read, scholarship:update, fees:read, staff:read, report:read.
- finance_officer: same finance group as bursar -> scholarship:read, scholarship:update, fees:read, staff:read, report:read.
- scholarship_officer: scholarship-access SCHOLARSHIP_OFFICER_ROLES (programs/applications/disbursements/compliance) -> scholarship:manage.
- examinations_officer: examination-access EXAM_OFFICER_ROLES (create/update/publish/delete) + gradebook REGISTRAR moderation + report exam_results -> examination:manage, gradebook:read, gradebook:update, report:read.
- counsellor: gateway CASE_WORKER -> case:manage.
- discipline_officer: gateway CASE_WORKER -> case:manage.
- communications_officer: communication-access staff + notification-access staff -> communication:manage, notification:manage.
- notification_admin: notification-access NOTIFICATION_STAFF_ROLES -> notification:manage.
- health_admin: health-service TENANT_WIDE_HEALTH_ROLES / PHI-log / break-glass approver -> health:manage.
- school_nurse: health-service HEALTH_AUTHORIZED_ROLES (PHI reader, school-bound; distinct from nurse) -> health:read.
- nurse: gateway block verbatim -> health:manage, student:read, student:list, parent:read.
- warden: hostel-access HOSTEL_STAFF_ROLES -> hostel:manage.
- librarian: library-access LIBRARY_STAFF_ROLES -> library:manage.
- transport_officer: transport-access TRANSPORT_STAFF_ROLES (read/write/ops) -> transport:manage.
- etl_engineer: etl-access ETL_STAFF_ROLES; gateway maps /pipelines->report -> report:manage.
- timetable_officer: timetable-access SCHEDULER_ROLES (write/publish/read) -> timetable:manage.
- subject_teacher: gradebook TEACHER_ROLES (grade.entry) + examination read + report academic -> gradebook:read/create/update, examination:read, assessment:read.
- class_teacher: attendance ATTENDANCE_WRITE_ROLES + gradebook TEACHER_ROLES + examination read -> attendance:read/create/update, gradebook:read/create/update, examination:read, assessment:read.
- board_admin: dashboards BOARD_ADMIN scope + lms TENANT_ADMIN_ROLES -> report:read, lms:read.
- board_officer: report EXAM_STAFF_ROLES + gradebook REGISTRAR + examination read -> report:read, gradebook:read/update, examination:read.
- board_regional_officer: dashboards BOARD_ADMIN scope -> report:read.
- ministry_admin: dashboards COUNTRY scope -> report:read.
- state_admin: dashboards STATE scope -> report:read.
- state_director: dashboards STATE scope -> report:read.
- parent: gateway block verbatim (portal self-writes + cross-domain reads).
- student: gateway block verbatim (portal self-writes + student-portal + cross-domain reads + lms create).
- applicant: scholarship document-access APPLICANT_ROLES (own-application read/submit) -> scholarship:read.

ROLES FLAGGED AMBIGUOUS FOR REVIEWER:
1. marks_clerk -- appears ONLY in packages/backend/examination/src/result-routes-rbac.test.ts as a 'simulated future divergence' mock fixture (exam.update), never in a production allow-list. Granted the narrowest examination:read consistent with that single reference. Reviewer should decide whether marks_clerk belongs in the production catalogue at all, or should be removed/renamed.
2. board_officer / examinations_officer gradebook grants -- gradebook REGISTRAR_ROLES authorize grade.moderate/transcript.issue/board_export.create (write-tier). Granted gradebook:read+update (not :manage or :create) to stay narrow; reviewer should confirm whether transcript/board-export warrant gradebook:create.
3. subject_teacher / class_teacher -- derived from TEACHER_ROLES co-membership; they are teaching sub-roles that never had their own DEFAULT_ROLES block. Grants mirror the teacher-tier gradebook/attendance writes they co-occur with. Reviewer should confirm these should not instead inherit the full base `teacher` block.

PRE-EXISTING (NOT introduced here, left untouched per baseline): eslint flags rbac.ts:14 'RoleAssignment' unused import and two require-await warnings in InMemoryAreaHierarchyResolver -- all on lines unchanged by this feature (verified against HEAD). The realm JSON and .test.ts eslint entries are config-default ignores, not errors in my code.
